idea-plugin.description:
Testin — test case management built into your IDE. Write, organize, execute, and report on your test cases next to your code. No server, no account, no external tool — everything is stored as local files.

✨ Manage
  • 📂 Test Project Tree: Organize test projects, test sets, and test runs in a sidebar tree. Create, rename, copy, cut, paste, and drag & drop — just like files.
  • ✍️ Test Case Editor: Each test case holds steps, expected result, priority, group, module, pre-conditions, and test data. Find anything fast with search, filters, and pagination.
  • 🧮 Excel-Style Grid: Edit test cases in a spreadsheet view — select rows or cell ranges, copy/cut/paste to and from Excel, rows auto-fit their content, and your column widths are remembered.
  • 📝 Bulk Editing: Change descriptions, steps, expected results, groups, and more across many test cases in one dialog.
  • 📊 Details Panel: See the full test case — attributes, metadata, and change history — in a panel on the right.
🏃 Execute
  • Test Runs: Pick test cases into a run and record results — Passed, Failed, Blocked, Untested, Pending — with execution notes and automatic duration timers.
  • Automation (with the Java & TestNG plugins): Generate test packages, classes, and methods from your test cases; run them by class or method; jump between a test case and its code with one click or a gutter icon.
📤 Share
  • Reports: One-click execution reports as HTML, PDF, Word, or Excel.
  • Import & Export: Bring test cases in from Excel, CSV, or JSON — and export them back out, including HTML.
  • Git (with the Git plugin): Review and commit test case changes, push and pull directly from the tree, clone a shared test project, and see which commit each run belongs to.
📋 Compatibility & Privacy
  • Your data stays yours: Zero telemetry, zero data collection. Everything lives in local files you control.
  • IDE Support: Installs on IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm, and other IntelliJ-based IDEs (build 261+). Test management works everywhere; code generation, TestNG execution, and Git features switch on automatically when the Java, TestNG, and Git plugins are present.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.7
  • Multi-IDE Support: Java, TestNG, and Git are now optional dependencies — Testin installs and runs on PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm, and other IntelliJ-based IDEs. Features that need a missing plugin degrade gracefully with a clear notification instead of failing.
  • Accurate Metadata: Plugin metadata is declared once in the build; the compatibility statement is verified against each supported IDE by the JetBrains Plugin Verifier.

2.6
  • Excel-Style Grid: Row selection from the sequence column, multi-row and multi-cell selection, Excel-compatible copy/cut/paste, and automatic row-height fitting after paste.
  • Layout Memory: User column widths survive refreshes; the list view opens by default and loads pages asynchronously.
  • Safer Persistence: Run status writes go through a single sequential writer, eliminating corrupted JSON under rapid status changes.
  • Zero-Setup Automation Path: The Java test source root is detected automatically at startup — no manual configuration.
  • Many stability fixes: dialog lifecycle cleanups, unified keyboard shortcuts, and grid editing edge cases.

2.5
  • Grid View: Content-based automatic column sizing with word wrap, uniform cell padding, and inline editing.
  • Run Creation Redesign: Collapsible sections, clearer layout, and wider input fields in the test run dialog.
  • Font Sync: Editor zoom is mirrored across the view panel for a consistent scale.
  • Drag & drop fixes in the project tree; newly created test cases are selected and scrolled into view.

2.4.1
  • Instant HTML Reporting: Added a one-click action to instantly generate and view clean, formatted HTML execution reports right from the toolbar.
  • Native Event Migration: Migrated background watchers to the verifier-safe postprocessor API to ensure full architectural compatibility with IntelliJ 2025.1+ and 2026 EAP editions.
  • Performance Refactoring: Optimized list rendering cycles by caching custom row boundaries and styling components, cutting down memory allocation overhead.

2.0.0
  • Initial Architecture Release: Introduced the core Test Project Tree sidebar navigation and dynamic, in-memory collection handlers.
  • Added the interactive Test Case Editor with pagination, background async loaders, and text query filtering.
  • Introduced the Test Run Manager tracking live test item execution state, manual status overrides, and runtime duration counters.
  • Integrated global application setting configurations under the IDE Tools menu group.
